# Goobers v0.5.2

This patch restores compatibility with Copilot CLI 1.0.103 while preserving
support for older compatible Copilot releases.

## Fixes

- Copilot session launches and fallback authentication probes use
  `--sync-session=off` with CLI 1.0.103 and newer, or `--no-remote-export`
  with older releases. Session export remains disabled.
- Configured session export flags are replaced with the version-appropriate
  opt-out, so stale launcher arguments do not break the upgraded CLI or
  override Goobers' export policy.
- An incompatible CLI or forwarding launcher now receives an actionable
  compatibility diagnostic instead of incorrectly reporting a newer CLI as
  too old.

## Operator guidance

The minimum supported Copilot CLI remains 1.0.52. After updating Goobers,
restart its supervised processes and run
`goobers validate --check-harness <instance-path>` under the service account.
Custom forwarding launchers must pass the selected opt-out through.

This patch retains the v0.5.1 security and intervention fixes. No DSL
support-policy changes are introduced.
